en.title: EU Disability Forum Seeks Feedback on Housing Simplification Package
en.summary: The European Disability Forum has opened consultation on its draft response to the EU Housing Simplification Package, aiming to shape accessibility-focused housing policy. Meanwhile, SEPTA began a $44 million accessibility upgrade at Philadelphia’s 11th Street Station, adding elevators and ramps. A new report shows most U.S. states comply with federal website accessibility rules, and the EU is offering inclusion grants for disability-inclusive higher education projects.

zh-TW.title: 歐殘論壇住房簡化套件諮詢
zh-TW.summary: 歐洲殘疾論壇已就其對歐盟住房簡化套件的草案回應開放諮詢，旨在塑造更具無障礙性的住房政策。同時，SEPTA 費城第11街車站啟動4400萬美元無障礙升級工程，新增電梯與坡道。報告顯示美國多數州已符合聯邦網站無障礙規則，而日本殘障射箭社群傳出霸凌指控，引發社會關注。
